critique: The render now reads clearly as a warm-orange firefly swarm on black, with a more irregular silhouette and visible change from t1 to t4. It is still concentrated as a dense central particle burst, especially at t4 where the center becomes a bright knot. The particles also appear to accumulate rapidly rather than linger as a spacious, loosely distributed swarm of individually wandering lights.

suggestions.why: Increasing particle velocity carries lights farther from the center, opening the swarm into a broader, less burst-like distribution.
A wider velocity spread breaks up the concentrated central flow and gives individual fireflies more varied outward wandering paths.
Longer particle life lets dispersed lights remain visible long enough to read as a lingering swarm rather than a rapidly refreshing emission burst.
Reducing the emission rate prevents the t4 frame from building into an overly dense bright core while the longer life preserves swarm presence.
